display.title: Episode 318: The Golden Cup of Eliyahu HaNavi (Shabbos Mevarchim Nissan)
display.summary_short: As Nissan approaches, Uncle Yossi teaches why children are at the center of Pesach, and tells how a poor woman who would not sell her Kos shel Eliyahu was rewarded by Eliyahu HaNavi.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week of Shabbos Mevarchim Nissan 5748. Uncle Yossi explains that children are at the heart of Pesach: Pharaoh's decree targeted Jewish babies, whom Hashem's angels protected, and the whole Seder is built to make children ask questions, 'v'higadta l'vincha'. Asking questions and finding the answers in the Torah keeps a nation healthy. After the Hakochainik march, two brothers recite the Shema. The story: Devorah treasures a golden, jeweled Kos shel Eliyahu passed down in her family. Before Pesach her poor husband Berel wants to sell it, but she refuses and trusts in Hashem. She takes in an old beggar during a storm, and he gives her a gold coin that keeps reappearing on her table after every purchase. On Seder night he returns and reveals that he is Eliyahu HaNavi, promising that Moshiach is coming sooner than we think. Uncle Yossi then speaks about miracles and the Geulah, reminds families about shmurah matzah, wine and selling chametz, announces Tzivos Hashem's Pesach Experience, and gives Shabbos candle time.
display.lesson: Trust in Hashem and honor His mitzvos even when it is hard; Hashem is a God of miracles, and Moshiach is coming sooner than we think.

date.note: Consistent with the audio: 'this Shabbos is Shabbos Mevarchim Chodesh Nissan'; candles Friday, March 11; Pesach Experience on Monday, April 4 (first day of Chol HaMoed).

advisories.note: Pharaoh's decree to throw Jewish baby boys into the Nile, told briefly; the babies are saved by angels.

sources_cited.note: Children ask and parents answer, 'as explained so clearly in the Haggadah'.
'This is what we say every day': belief in the coming of Moshiach.
